proof_0289.moves: A definitional simp lemma: the object part of the unopFunctor sending right resolutions of a localizer morphism to left resolutions of its opposite is literally the construction unfolded, so the proof is rfl. The real content is the definition of unopFunctor and the op/unop transport, not any cited theorem.

proof_0290.moves: Induction over membership in the additive submonoid closure of a set: the gcd of the set divides each generator, divides zero, and divides any sum of two things it divides. The three-case closure induction is the whole argument.

proof_0291.moves: Pure definitional unfolding: the underlying multilinear map of the continuous multilinear map produced by ofSubsingleton (from a continuous linear map on the single index) is by construction the corresponding multilinear map, so rfl closes it. No citation names the content.

proof_0292.moves: Unwrap the Raw tree map to its internal Impl representation, extract the well-formedness witness from the Raw.WF hypothesis, and apply the already-proved Impl-level statement that isEmpty agrees with size = 0.

proof_0293.moves: The coercion of a Finset to a sort is the subtype of elements satisfying membership, so nonempty of that subtype is exactly the existence of a member; nonempty_subtype does it in one step.

proof_0294.moves: A HashMap is a thin wrapper on a DHashMap with constant value type; unfold to the inner map and cite the dependent-map version of the lemma verbatim. Pure delegation.

proof_0295.moves: A Subarray's iteration is defined via the generic slice iterator, so the forIn-over-toArray statement is exactly the generic slice lemma after unfolding the iterator instances. Delegation plus instance transport.

proof_0296.moves: Push the statement about the wrapped HashMap.Raw down to the inner DHashMap.Raw, feed it the well-formedness witness via WF.out, and cite the dependent-map lemma for getKeyD after insertIfNew.

proof_0297.moves: A component-at-index-0 lemma for a natural transformation between two-step composable arrows; both sides reduce to the same composite by definitional unfolding, so it is rfl. The content is the definition of the transformation, not any cited fact.

proof_0298.moves: Repackage the DHashMap as the subtype-with-nonempty-buckets form Raw0 (using the stored size-positivity proof and the map's well-formedness), then apply the corresponding Raw0-level lemma that inserting a key makes getKey of that key return it.

proof_0299.moves: Build the ContinuousStar instance on the multiplicative opposite: star on M-op is op composed with star composed with unop, and each of the three factors is continuous, so the composite is. Constructor plus composition of continuities.

proof_0300.moves: If two valuation subrings have equal associated local subrings, apply the underlying-subring map to that equality to get equal subrings, then use injectivity of toSubring on valuation subrings.

proof_0301.moves: Compute the source/target components of the left unitor's forward map in the Dial category: a composite of product lifts is simplified by pushing composition inside the lift, collapsing the map to the terminal object by uniqueness, and cancelling identities, leaving the second projection.

proof_0302.moves: Rotating a list by its own length returns it: rewrite rotate' as drop n ++ take n with n = length (needs length <= length), then drop of the full length is nil and take of the full length is the list, so nil ++ l = l.

proof_0303.moves: A constant map is continuous, and global continuity implies continuity within any set at any point. Two citations chained; nothing else.

proof_0304.moves: Rewrite the membership condition pointwise under the universal quantifier: a set is contained in powersetCard n univ exactly when every member has card n, using the characterization of membership in powersetCard of univ. Rewriting under a binder is the real structure.

proof_0305.moves: The inverse functor of the self-duality equivalence on Boolean algebras is by construction the stated functor, so the proof is rfl. Purely definitional.

proof_0306.moves: Assemble HasFiniteLimits for a comma category from its constructor: for each finite (small) index category, limits of that shape in the comma category already exist as an instance, so typeclass inference discharges each case. The proof is instance assembly.

proof_0307.moves: Counting occurrences equal to a given element before an index is the predicate-version count with the beq predicate, so the zero-index lemma is literally the predicate lemma. Pure delegation.

proof_0308.moves: Transfer both sides to the sorted list model of the tree: minKey? on the tree agrees with minKey? on toListModel (needs the ordering part of well-formedness), the list lemma says minKey? is none exactly when the list is empty, and isEmpty on the tree agrees with isEmpty on the list model.

proof_0309.moves: Every element of an additive group is an additive unit, so the general statement for additive units about translation preserving the uniformity applies verbatim to group elements.

proof_0310.moves: A HashSet is a HashMap with Unit values, so get? on the empty set is the getKey? of the empty map; cite that lemma directly.

proof_0311.moves: Use the left characterization of disjointness: take x in Ico a b, so x < b, and suppose x in Ico b c, so b <= x; those contradict. Membership unfolding plus the strict-less-than/not-greater-equal clash.

proof_0312.moves: Dropping n from the first n elements: rewrite drop-of-take into take of (n - n) applied to the dropped list, note n - n = 0, and take 0 is the empty list.
